Your headline, as real text.

This page reads and works before the scene loads, with motion reduced, and with no WebGL at all. Keep that true as you build.

Primary actionSecond action

  • Content first

    Headings, copy and links are plain HTML. The scene is added on top and can vanish without loss.

  • Three states

    Full effect, a still frame for reduced motion, and a fallback when the graphics card says no.

  • One theme

    The scene reads the same tokens as the page, so a new direction restyles both at once.
